title: Last-Iterate Stationarity of Muon with Finitely Many Newton-Schulz Iterations
abstract: arXiv:2610.34158v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Muon has achieved strong empirical performance in large-scale language-model training, motivating a better theoretical understanding of its practical implementation. Unlike the idealized polar-factor update, practical Muon uses a fixed number of quintic Newton--Schulz iterations. Existing analyses mainly establish average- or best-iterate stationarity guarantees, leaving last-iterate convergence less understood. We study last-iterate gradient convergence of practical finite-step Muon on smooth, lower-bounded nonconvex objectives.   For deterministic gradients, we show that without input stabilization, Muon can cycle even on a smooth convex quadratic. With positive stabilization, we establish last-iterate gradient convergence for any fixed momentum coefficient below one and a sufficiently small constant learning rate, together with square-summability of gradients. translated_title: 有限次Newton-Schulz迭代下Muon的末次迭代平稳性
translated_abstract: Muon在大规模语言模型训练中取得了出色的实证效果，这促使人们对其具体实现进行更深入的理论理解。与理想化的极因子更新不同，实际使用的Muon采用固定次数的五次Newton–Schulz迭代。现有分析主要建立了平均迭代或最优迭代的平稳性保证，而对末次迭代的收敛性理解仍然不足。我们研究了实际的有限步Muon在光滑、下有界的非凸目标函数上的末次迭代梯度收敛性。对于确定性梯度，我们证明在没有输入稳定化的情况下，Muon即使在光滑凸二次函数上也可能产生循环；在正稳定化条件下，我们对任意小于1的固定动量系数以及足够小的常数学习率建立了末次迭代梯度收敛性，并同时证明了梯度的平方可和性。对于随机梯度，我们首先证明持续有界、无偏的噪声（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 本文首次为采用有限次Newton-Schulz迭代的实用Muon优化器建立了末次迭代梯度收敛保证，证明在正稳定化和小常数学习率下可实现非凸目标的末次迭代平稳性，而无稳定化时即使在凸二次函数上也会循环。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes last-iterate gradient convergence guarantees for practical Muon with finitely many Newton-Schulz iterations, showing that with positive stabilization and a sufficiently small learning rate, last-iterate stationarity holds on smooth nonconvex objectives, while without stabilization Muon can cycle even on a convex quadratic.
